title: Open PDF via welcome screen
setup: npm run dev (Vite dev server must be running)
expected_visible_result: Welcome screen disappears; floating page indicator shows '1 / 3'; [data-testid='rendered-page'] is visible with a non-empty src blob URL
visual_checkpoints: viewer-empty-state is NOT in DOM after load
failure_meaning: Document open flow is broken — the viewer does not transition from welcome to document state
notes_for_codex: The loadDocument() hook accepts a path string or an ArrayBuffer. Pass the path string. The hook is only available in dev mode (Vite). In preview mode, use the file input flow instead via [data-testid='welcome-open-btn'].

title: Render first page (PNG from browser-test harness)
steps: Assert the img element has a blob: src attribute
Assert the img naturalWidth > 0 (i.e. image loaded successfully)
expected_visible_result: A rendered PDF page image is visible in the viewport. The page renders white with visible text content.
visual_checkpoints: No error message in page-view area
failure_meaning: browser-test render engine failed — PdfDoc.renderPage() returned an error or empty bytes. Check browser console for browser-test render errors.
notes_for_codex: Use page.locator('[data-testid="rendered-page"]').evaluate(el => el.naturalWidth) to assert the image loaded. A src of 'blob:' with naturalWidth=0 means the blob is empty (render failure).

title: Page navigation (prev/next/jump-to-page)
steps: Clear and type '1' into [data-testid='nav-go-to-page-input'], press Enter
expected_visible_result: Page indicator updates on each navigation step; rendered-page img src changes to a new blob URL on each page change
visual_checkpoints: floating-page-indicator text changes after next/prev clicks
rendered-page src changes after navigation (different blob URL)
failure_meaning: Page navigation is broken — either the indicator does not update or the engine fails to render the new page
notes_for_codex: Use page.locator('[data-testid="floating-page-indicator"]').textContent() to read the current page label. For the nav-go-to-page-input, use fill('1') then keyboard.press('Enter').

title: Zoom in / zoom out
steps: Find the Zoom in tool button: getByTitle('Zoom in') — must NOT have 'not yet available' in title
Assert rendered-page img width equals viewport width (fit-to-width)
expected_visible_result: Zoom display updates; rendered page image visually grows/shrinks accordingly
expected_capability_gating: Zoom buttons must be enabled (not disabled) in browser-test: getWiredTools(false) includes 'toolbar.zoomIn', 'toolbar.zoomOut'
visual_checkpoints: Zoom in/out buttons are NOT disabled (no disabled attribute)
failure_meaning: Zoom controls are broken or incorrectly gated. If disabled: wiredTools configuration regressed.
notes_for_codex: Zoom buttons in ModeToolbar do not have data-testid — locate them by title attribute: page.getByTitle('Zoom in'). The ModeToolbar ToolButton sets title to t(tool.label) when wired or t(tool.label) + ' (not yet available)' when not wired. Assert no '(not yet available)' suffix.

title: Search text in document
setup: Load 3-page sample-text.pdf containing known text (e.g. 'Lorem ipsum')
steps: Find the Search text tool button in ModeToolbar: getByTitle('Search text')
Click it — this opens the left-rail search panel
Assert [data-testid='search-result-count'] text is not empty (e.g. 'N results')
Assert at least one [data-testid='search-result-item'] is visible
Assert the page indicator jumps to the page containing the result
expected_visible_result: Search panel opens in left rail; results list populates; clicking a result navigates to the matching page
expected_capability_gating: Search text tool must be enabled (in getWiredTools(false))
visual_checkpoints: search-panel is visible after clicking Search text tool
At least one search-result-item is in DOM
failure_meaning: Text extraction (PdfDoc.text() or PdfDoc.getTextPositions()) is broken, or the search panel does not open
notes_for_codex: The Search text toolbar button opens the left-rail search panel (not the command palette). The command palette (search-btn in TopBar / Meta+K) is for commands, not in-document text search. The search is client-side over extracted text positions.

title: Select text on canvas (if automatable)
setup: Load sample-text.pdf with known text content
steps: Simulate a mouse drag across a text span in the rendered-page area
Assert at least one text-context-action button is visible inside text-context-bar
expected_visible_result: Text context bar floats above the selected text. Actions like 'Highlight' or 'Copy' are visible.
failure_meaning: Text layer extraction or rendering is broken — PdfDoc.getTextPositions() returned empty or the TextInteractionOverlay is not mounted
notes_for_codex: Text spans are positioned as transparent overlays over the rendered-page img. The TextInteractionOverlay mounts only when textSpans (from useSearch hook) are available. If sample-text.pdf has no extractable text, this test cannot pass. Verify the fixture has real selectable text.

title: Add highlight annotation via selection
setup: Blocked: browser-test harness exposes no PdfDoc.addHighlight runtime export
steps: Do not run as a click-through scenario until native Tauri commands expose highlight creation in the browser build
Assert runtime capability status remains apiAvailableButRuntimeMissing
Assert [data-testid='annotation-tool-highlight'] is not shown in browser-test
expected_visible_result: N/A — highlight creation is a runtime product gap in the current browser-test harness.
expected_capability_gating: add-highlight status is apiAvailableButRuntimeMissing. annotation-tool-highlight must not be visible in browser-test until PdfDoc.addHighlight is exported at runtime.
visual_checkpoints: annotation-tool-highlight is NOT in DOM (runtime gap)
annotation-tool-underline is NOT in DOM (browser-test gating)
annotation-tool-strikeout is NOT in DOM (browser-test gating)
annotation-tool-rectangle is NOT in DOM (browser-test gating)
annotation-tool-redaction is NOT in DOM (browser-test gating)
comment-filter-count does not change from unsupported browser-test creation
failure_meaning: If this scenario runs as a beta-blocker, the scenario classification regressed. If the tool is visible, unsupported browser-test annotation creation is being presented as usable.
notes_for_codex: Rust source contains PdfDoc.addHighlight behind the annotate feature, but the browser-test feature excludes annotate. Tauri command surface does not expose addHighlight.

Assert runtime capability status remains apiAvailableButRuntimeMissing
Assert [data-testid='add-comment-btn'] is not shown in browser-test
expected_visible_result: N/A — sticky-note creation is a runtime product gap in the current browser-test harness.
expected_capability_gating: add-sticky-note status is apiAvailableButRuntimeMissing. add-comment-btn must not be visible in browser-test until PdfDoc.addStickyNote is exported at runtime.
visual_checkpoints: add-comment-btn is NOT in DOM (runtime gap)
comment-filter-count does not change from unsupported browser-test creation
failure_meaning: If this scenario runs as a beta-blocker, the scenario classification regressed. If add-comment-btn is visible in browser-test, unsupported sticky-note creation is being presented as usable.

title: Add free text annotation (engine-level only)
steps: NOTE: There is no dedicated free text annotation button in ViewerApp (/?v2).
browser-test harness reports free text unsupported because the browser-test harness does not expose PdfDoc.addFreeText().
Test via direct engine call: window.__pdfluent_test__ does not expose createAnnotation() directly.
This scenario cannot be automated against ViewerApp until a free text tool button is added to the annotation toolbar.
expected_visible_result: N/A — no UI to trigger this operation in ViewerApp
expected_capability_gating: add-free-text status is apiAvailableButRuntimeMissing and there is no free text toolbar button.
failure_meaning: Scenario is blocked because the current browser-test harness does not expose PdfDoc.addFreeText.

title: Export annotated PDF (browser download)
setup: Blocked: depends on VE-007 or VE-008, which are runtime product gaps in browser-test
steps: Do not run as an annotated-export scenario until browser-test annotation creation exists
Keep clean PDF export covered by VE-017/VE-021
expected_visible_result: N/A — annotated export is blocked by missing browser-test annotation creation.
expected_capability_gating: In browser-test, only 'pdf' format is offered in the select. All other formats (compressed_pdf, png, jpeg, docx, xlsx, pptx) must not appear.
visual_checkpoints: Scenario is skipped until annotation creation runtime exports exist
failure_meaning: If this scenario runs as a beta-blocker before annotation creation is exported, the scenario classification regressed.
notes_for_codex: Clean browser PDF export remains covered by VE-017/VE-021. Annotated export should be restored when PdfDoc.addHighlight or PdfDoc.addStickyNote exists in Tauri command surface.

title: XFA detection banner shown for XFA document
setup: Load sample-xfa.pdf (a PDF with XFA form data, so pdfDoc.xfaDetected === true)
steps: Assert the XFA warning banner is visible:
Locate: page.getByText('contains XFA form data') or page.locator('.bg-amber-500\/10')
Assert the banner text matches: 'This document contains XFA form data. Some content may not display correctly'
Switch to Read mode and open RightContextPanel
Assert [data-testid='doc-info-form-type'] shows 'XFA' or 'XFA Static' / 'XFA Dynamic' / 'XFA Hybrid'
expected_visible_result: An amber/yellow warning banner appears below the mode toolbar. The doc-info panel's form type field shows an XFA variant.
expected_capability_gating: The banner is rendered only when pdfDoc.xfaDetected === true. For non-XFA PDFs it must not appear.
visual_checkpoints: Banner contains the text 'XFA form data'
failure_meaning: XFA detection is not working — either the native document parser does not set xfaDetected, or the ViewerApp UI banner condition is broken
notes_for_codex: The XFA banner can be located by visible text. The fixture sample-xfa.pdf contains an app-owned /XFA marker and is valid for detection workflow testing; deep packet-removal proof requires a redistributable real XFA fixture.

title: Flatten XFA from XFA banner
steps: Wait for the XFA banner to disappear
Assert the rendered page still displays
expected_visible_result: The XFA banner disappears and the current document remains rendered.
expected_exported_file_result: A valid PDF is exported from the current document after flattening and exported bytes reopen successfully. Byte-difference and deep packet-removal assertions require a redistributable real XFA fixture, not the synthetic marker fixture.
expected_capability_gating: TauriTransformEngine.flattenXfa() is available in browser-test; TauriTransformEngine.flattenXfa() is NOT available (returns notImpl)
failure_meaning: Flatten UI or TauriTransformEngine.flattenXfa() failed even though PdfDoc.flattenXfa is exposed in the current browser-test harness.
notes_for_codex: The XFA banner button calls engine.transform.flattenXfa(pdfDoc), replaces the current document, marks it dirty, and export downloads valid PDF bytes. The current fixture supports workflow and reopen checks; it must not be used for byte-difference or real XFA packet-removal proof.

title: Export after XFA flatten
steps: After flattening XFA (VE-012), open export dialog
Verify downloaded file does not contain XFA data
expected_visible_result: Export completes; downloaded PDF reopens without the XFA banner for the current app fixture
expected_exported_file_result: Valid PDF bytes that reopen successfully. Byte-difference and no-/XFA packet assertions require a redistributable real XFA fixture.
expected_capability_gating: Export uses current canonical browser-test bytes after flattenXfa replacement.
failure_meaning: Browser export after flatten failed or produced a non-PDF. If a byte-difference or no-/XFA assertion is needed, replace sample-xfa.pdf with a redistributable real XFA fixture.
notes_for_codex: This is implemented in the same Playwright flow as VE-012. The current fixture contains a synthetic /XFA marker comment for viewer detection, so tests must not assert that the marker string disappears.

title: PDF/A validate from Convert panel
steps: Assert [data-testid='pdfa-status'] contains a PDF/A validation result
expected_visible_result: The Convert panel shows PDF/A controls and displays a validation result.
expected_capability_gating: TauriValidationEngine.validatePdfA() is implemented. TauriValidationEngine.validatePdfA() invokes 'validate_pdfa' Tauri command.
visual_checkpoints: pdfa-panel is visible in Convert mode
failure_meaning: PDF/A validation UI or TauriValidationEngine.validatePdfA() failed even though PdfDoc.validatePdfA is exposed in the current browser-test harness.
notes_for_codex: The app exposes PDF/A controls in the Convert right panel, not the toolbar.

title: Convert to PDF/A-2B from Convert panel
steps: Export the PDF and assert a valid PDF download
expected_visible_result: The Convert panel reports successful PDF/A conversion and the document remains exportable.
expected_exported_file_result: A converted PDF is downloaded. The current SDK conversion may still report validation issues for minimal fixtures; this scenario checks mutation/export lifecycle, not conformance perfection.
expected_capability_gating: TauriTransformEngine.convertToPdfa() is in TauriPdfEngine.supportedOperations: ['merge', 'append-document', 'flatten-xfa', 'convert-pdfa']
failure_meaning: PDF/A conversion UI, byte replacement, or browser export after conversion failed even though PdfDoc.convertToPdfa is exposed in the current browser-test harness.
notes_for_codex: The app calls engine.transform.convertToPdfA(doc, '2b'), replaces current canonical bytes, marks dirty, and browser export clears dirty after download.

title: Merge PDFs (Tauri append flow)
setup: Run in Tauri desktop build — not testable in browser-test harness
steps: Assert organize-merge-pdf-btn is NOT disabled (Tauri runtime)
A native file picker dialog appears — select tests/fixtures/sample-b.pdf
Wait for task queue to show 'done' status
Assert floating-page-indicator shows increased page count (e.g. '1 / N+M')
expected_visible_result: Page count increases after merge. The organize-grid shows more page tiles.
expected_exported_file_result: A merged PDF combining both input documents
expected_capability_gating: In browser-test: organize-merge-pdf-btn has 'disabled' attribute. In Tauri: it is enabled.
visual_checkpoints: organize-merge-pdf-btn is NOT disabled in Tauri
page count increases after file selection
organize-grid tile count matches new page count
failure_meaning: Merge (append) operation failed in Tauri backend, or the native file dialog did not fire
notes_for_codex: In browser-test the button is always disabled: disabled={!isTauri || ...}. The browser-test harness supports merge at the API level (PdfDoc.merge(otherBytes)) but the ViewerApp UI exposes it only via Tauri. To test browser-test merge, you would need to invoke the engine directly via the test hook — not possible with the current window.__pdfluent_test__ API.

title: Browser PDF download (clean document, no annotations)
steps: Assert export-format-select has exactly 1 option with value 'pdf'
Set up Playwright download listener: const downloadPromise = page.waitForEvent('download')
Read first 5 bytes of downloaded file and assert they equal '%PDF-'
expected_visible_result: Download starts immediately after clicking Export. The dialog closes.
expected_exported_file_result: A valid PDF file (starts with '%PDF-'). File size should be >= 50 bytes.
expected_capability_gating: Only 'pdf' format available in browser-test. BROWSER_FORMATS = new Set(['pdf']) in ExportDialog.tsx.
failure_meaning: browser-test PDF export is completely broken. This is a severity-1 beta blocker.
notes_for_codex: The ExportDialog lazily imports the component — if clicking export-btn and the dialog doesn't appear within 3 seconds, the lazy load or the ViewerApp isExportOpen state is broken. Use page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="export-dialog"]', {state: 'visible', timeout: 5000}).

title: Tauri save / export to filesystem
setup: Make a change (add highlight or comment) to set isDirty=true
steps: A native 'Save As' dialog appears — choose an output path
Wait for task queue to show 'Saved' status
Assert [data-testid='undo-btn'] is present (document is still open)
Assert isDirty becomes false (save-as-btn may update its visual state)
expected_visible_result: Document is saved to the selected path. Task bar briefly shows 'Saving...' then 'Saved'.
expected_exported_file_result: A valid PDF at the chosen filesystem path, containing the applied annotations
expected_capability_gating: Save-as uses Tauri 'save_pdf' command. In browser-test: save-as-btn calls onSaveAs() which triggers the export dialog instead.
visual_checkpoints: task queue shows 'done' status after save
failure_meaning: Tauri save_pdf command failed or the dialog was cancelled unexpectedly
notes_for_codex: In browser-test, save-as-btn triggers handleSaveAs which opens the export dialog (not a native save dialog). In Tauri, it calls @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog save(). Use WebdriverIO or Tauri-specific test tooling for native dialog interactions — Playwright cannot interact with OS-native dialogs.

title: browser-test: organize mode tools are disabled
setup: Switch to Organize mode: page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Organize', exact: true}).click()
steps: Assert [data-testid='batch-action-bar'] is NOT visible (no pages selected yet)
Assert no task appears in BottomTaskBar
expected_visible_result: Organize mode shows page thumbnails but all mutating buttons are disabled. Clicking disabled buttons produces no side effects.
expected_capability_gating: getWiredTools(false) does NOT include 'toolbar.deletePage', 'toolbar.rotateLeft', 'toolbar.rotateRight'. OrganizeGrid.organize-merge-pdf-btn: disabled={!isTauri || ...}
visual_checkpoints: No task queue entry after clicking disabled button
failure_meaning: Capability gating regressed — browser-test can now trigger page deletion or merging which it shouldn't be able to do
notes_for_codex: The per-page [data-testid='organize-delete-{i}'] and [data-testid='organize-rotate-{i}'] buttons in the grid may also be disabled in browser-test. Check them too: locator('[data-testid="organize-delete-0"]').isDisabled(). Batch action buttons: disabled={!isTauri || ...} in OrganizeGrid.

title: browser-test: annotation creation tools hidden when runtime exports are missing
expected_visible_result: No annotation creation controls are visible in browser-test harness while native Tauri annotation commands are missing.
expected_capability_gating: ModeToolbar annotationTools array is empty in browser-test; add-comment is Tauri-only until PdfDoc.addStickyNote exists in Tauri command surface.
failure_meaning: Annotation toolbar browser-test gating regressed — unsupported annotation creation is being shown in browser mode
notes_for_codex: Use locator.count() and assert all creation controls equal 0. These buttons are conditionally rendered (not just disabled) in browser-test while runtime exports are absent.

title: browser-test: export dialog shows only PDF format
steps: Assert no option with value 'compressed_pdf' exists
Assert no option with value 'png' exists
Assert no option with value 'jpeg' exists
Assert no option with value 'docx' exists
Assert no option with value 'xlsx' exists
Assert no option with value 'pptx' exists
expected_visible_result: Export format dropdown has exactly one option: 'PDF'
expected_capability_gating: BROWSER_FORMATS = new Set(['pdf']) in ExportDialog.tsx. Filter: .filter(f => isTauri || BROWSER_FORMATS.has(f))
failure_meaning: Export format gating regressed — formats that require Tauri native commands are now being offered in the browser
notes_for_codex: const options = await page.locator('[data-testid="export-format-select"] option').all(); then check options.length === 1 and (await options[0].getAttribute('value')) === 'pdf'.

title: browser-test: clicking a disabled tool produces no side effect
steps: Note the current page count from floating-page-indicator
Attempt to click organize-merge-pdf-btn (use page.locator(...).click({ force: true }))
Assert no entries appeared in BottomTaskBar task queue
Assert floating-page-indicator page count is unchanged
Assert no toast or error message is visible
expected_visible_result: Nothing happens. No task queue entry, no toast, no page count change.
expected_capability_gating: ModeToolbar ToolButton: disabled={!wired}, onClick={wired ? onClick : undefined}. Disabled buttons have no click handler.
visual_checkpoints: No new entries in BottomTaskBar after click
No error or success toast visible
failure_meaning: A disabled tool button is dispatching actions or showing toasts — capability gating is broken
notes_for_codex: Use { force: true } to click a disabled button (bypass Playwright's disabled-click guard). The ModeToolbar ToolButton sets onClick={undefined} when !wired, so the click should silently do nothing. Use page.locator('[data-task-queue-item]') or inspect the BottomTaskBar to verify no task was pushed.

title: browser-test: OCR scan tool is disabled in convert mode
steps: Find the OCR scan tool button in ModeToolbar: getByTitle('OCR scan (not yet available)')
Assert it has the 'disabled' HTML attribute
Assert its title contains '(not yet available)'
Assert its CSS includes opacity-40 or similar disabled styling (class 'text-muted-foreground/40 cursor-default')
expected_visible_result: The OCR scan button is visually greyed out with a 'not yet available' tooltip in browser-test
expected_capability_gating: getWiredTools(false) does NOT include 'toolbar.ocrScan'. getWiredTools(true) DOES include it.
visual_checkpoints: OCR scan button is present but disabled in convert mode browser-test
failure_meaning: OCR scan is incorrectly enabled in browser-test — clicking it would silently fail or error since no browser-test OCR engine is wired
notes_for_codex: The OCR tool button has no data-testid in ModeToolbar. Locate it by title: page.getByTitle('OCR scan (not yet available)'). In English locale the title is 'OCR scan (not yet available)' when disabled.

title: browser-test: redact draw button hidden in protect mode
steps: Assert [data-testid='annotation-tool-redaction-protect'] does NOT exist in DOM (count === 0)
Confirm: in ModeToolbar, the protect-mode redaction toggle is wrapped in {mode === 'protect' && pageCount > 0 && isTauri && ...} — isTauri is false in browser-test, so button is not rendered
expected_visible_result: The redact draw toggle button does not appear in the protect mode toolbar in browser-test
expected_capability_gating: ModeToolbar: protect mode redaction toggle condition: mode === 'protect' && pageCount > 0 && isTauri
failure_meaning: Redaction draw tool is incorrectly shown in browser-test harness — the isTauri guard failed
notes_for_codex: page.locator('[data-testid="annotation-tool-redaction-protect"]').count() must equal 0 in browser-test. This is a DOM-existence check, not a disabled-attribute check. The button is simply not rendered when !isTauri.
